digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init currently creates an empty orphan branch when fetch fails or times out, instead of failing closed with a diagnostic
The advertisement probe using git ls-remote must distinguish three states: branch advertised (return 0), reachable but absent (return 2), and remote unreachable or timeout (return 124)

All four consumers of the remote-branch predicate (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share one cached tri-state result keyed by repo, remote, and branch

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount with no error, while strict init must fail nonzero and never create an orphan unless force_new_store=True is explicitly supplied
The --force-new-store flag must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; it has no effect when the remote is reachable
Unreachable, advertised-fetch-failed, and reachable-absent cases must each emit distinct actionable error messages naming the remote, branch, timeout, and remediation
